banner_text: Galatasaray v Amedspor (top two meet), Çorum FK v Fenerbahçe, Alanyaspor v Trabzonspor and Beşiktaş v Gençlerbirliği. No UK broadcaster is confirmed for 2026/27 — in Türkiye every match is live on beIN SPORTS and TOD. Then it's the international break: Türkiye v Belgium on Thursday.
